assets.name: packsmith
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final application icon for Packsmith, a modern native desktop archive manager that creates, explores, edits and extracts archives, including preserved classic Macintosh files. Create ONE polished standalone square application icon: a compact archive box with a bold central zipper/clasp, incorporating a subtle forged-metal/anvil-like base into the same simple silhouette to suggest the smith name. Restrained harmonious two-tone colors, precise edges, understated dimensional highlights, distinctive and professional. Prioritize a strong readable silhouette and large simple forms that survive at 16, 24, 32 and 48 pixels. Center the mark with generous equal safe padding; no circular enclosing badge, no background tile, no scenery. True transparent background outside the mark. No text, letters, wordmark, tiny decorative details, watermarks, mockup, multiple concepts, or contact sheet. Deliver a high-resolution square master suitable for conversion to Windows ICO and PNG size variants.

assets.name: packsmith-archive
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: companion archive-document icon for Packsmith. Transform the supplied Packsmith application icon into ONE matching document/file icon. Preserve its warm golden archive box, dark zipper, metal materials and polished desktop-icon style. Put a large simplified version of the box-and-zipper mark on the face of a thick light silver paper/document silhouette with one clearly folded corner; omit the anvil base for this document variant. A distinct file glyph, not a duplicate application silhouette. Keep the emblem large and readable at 24 and 32 pixels, generous even safe padding, centered square composition. True transparent background outside the document; no background tile or scenery. No letters, filenames, text, badge, watermark, multiple options or contact sheet. High-resolution square master for Windows ICO and PNG variants.

integration: Application/Explorer/taskbar icon, native version resources, in-app branding and Open action; archive icon asset available for future associations
